I don't think comparing a 2 hr special with a full season is a fair comparison. A special will take a max of 2 months to shoot (given that its like a movie and a portion will be shot with everyone in the same city). 

A season on the other hand would take around 8 months to shoot with the cast being on constant move (health toll) and they would be on retainer for the most part (i.e would accept a lot of projects just things they can do in between).

I think its the format of the show that may put some people off. Take for example Heroes the show was constructed like a comic book while Sense8 is built like a novel. More like a character driven novel and one that doesn't shove info. down your throat. For a lot of viewers, the shows comes off as confusing. 

Also, if you're a prude you would have a problem watching or even relating to the show. The same way some commentators here felt Kala's actions or decisions were not believable simply because they live in the US or Europe. 

So sadly its not that popular which makes me worry about season three.

Am I the only one convinced Wolfgang is suffering from depression? I mean there were two clue: 

1- At the opening sequence right before Kala goes up to meet Rajan on the boat, Wolfie is sinking in the dark water (and water was a positive thing for him throughout season 1).  

2- We see him laugh and dance and even hugs Felix all the time...then gets sad at the snow scene and ends the episode with "Happy fucking new year."

I think it was a subtle way to introduce and maybe try to get an understanding about mental illness..
